title: refactor: reorganize code into modules
body:
## Code Reorganization into Modules
This PR reorganizes the codebase into separate modules to improve maintainability and separation of concerns. The changes split the monolithic index.ts into dedicated modules, each responsible for a specific aspect of the application:

### Changes
- **Chat Module** (src/chat/index.ts): Handles chat interface and message handling
- **Database Module** (src/database/index.ts): Manages database initialization and connections
- **Cache Module** (src/cache/index.ts): Handles cache management and initialization
- **Clients Module** (src/clients/index.ts): Manages client initialization and lifecycle
- **Config Module** (src/config/index.ts): Handles configuration loading and token management
- **Main Module** (src/index.ts): Orchestrates the application using the new modular structure

### Benefits
- Better code organization
- Clearer separation of concerns
- Improved maintainability
- Easier to understand and modify individual components

### Testing
The changes have been tested by running the application and verifying that all functionality works as before, including:

- Character loading
- Chat interaction
- Database operations
- Client initialization
